name: finance-stack-validation-fixes
description: Trigger when working in a self-hosted personal-finance stack (SQLCipher + Plaid + Anthropic SDK) and (1) editing CSV/OFX ingestion, (2) designing dedup keys or sign-convention handling, (3) building a deterministic rules layer in front of an LLM categorizer, or (4) tightening a 'catch-all' category. Verified on /srv/finance (Ubuntu, Python 3.12) 2026-05-18.
